messages:
maria: Quick follow-up to the onboarding RFC — proposal: add a lightweight "lint" stage (pre-bench) that catches interface contractions and obvious runtime mismatches so we fail fast before expensive bench runs. thinking: removed outputs, changed shapes, kv-cache proto incompat, and missing ops.

eitan: +1. we saw a costly run last week where shape mismatch only surfaced in the 4h bench. what are we calling this? admit-lint or smoke-lint?

sam: admit-lint sounds good. two levels: hard fail (contract removed) and soft warn (new optional outputs, minor shape widening). soft warns still let bench continue but tag results.

maria: agree. goal is <5s check on upload. keep it deterministic and cheap. we should avoid running any model forward pass if possible.

jia: How about a signature-based approach: compute a compact "model signature" from model metadata + exported IO types + op list, and compare against allowed contract for the target runtime. if signature changed in a breaking way -> hard fail. pseudo: ```sha256(json.dumps({"inputs":...,"outputs":...,"ops":...}, sort_keys=True))```

eitan: we should also validate actual param dtype/shape placeholders for runtime kernels (e.g., if sequence_dim changed from -1 to 0). metadata-only catches many but not all. maybe try a tiny schema validator that reads exported ONNX/torchscript header (no weights). cheap parse.

luke: to reduce false-positives, we can map model-signature -> runtime-compatibility-tags (kv-cacheable, rotary-pos, flash-attn). onboarding table already stores these tags. lint should ensure tags are consistent with detected ops.

sam: operationally: flow = ingest -> admit-lint -> admit-smoke (tiny forward pass on single sample) -> full bench. admit-lint must be able to run synchronously on upload and return structured diagnostics for UI/CLI.

maria: right. UI should show actionable diff: e.g., "output 'logits' missing (was required)" or "input 'past_key_values' shape changed (T,N)->(N,T)". include suggested fix (rename/mapping) when feasible.

jia: for proto/kv-cache mismatches, lint should check presence/ordering of cache tensors and shapes. if absent but runtime expects, fail hard. if present but shape variant, mark warn.

eitan: edge case: model intentionally reduces outputs (we sometimes strip logits to save memory). need explicit opt-in metadata to allow contract reduction. plan: add metadata field "contract_mode": ["strict","compat"] where compat allows certain removals but requires consumer-side fallback.

luke: good call. default to strict. enterprise customers can opt into compat for legacy reason.

onboard-bot: deploy: admit-lint v0.1 will be rolled to staging tonight (1768004200). logs will stream to #eng-ml for 24h.

sam: questions: should admit-lint run per-model-version or per-model-family? I vote per-version; family-level is too coarse and hides regressions.

maria: per-version. also we need a human-review override for exceptional cases. record override comment in registry.

jia: implementation plan (short): 1) extractor: small parser to extract IO/ops header from exported artifact; 2) signature builder + comparator; 3) schema rules (yaml) that map to hard/soft rules; 4) registry UI annotations for diagnostics. estimate 2 wks for v0.1.

eitan: + owners? maria (requirements + UI), jia (extractor + sig), sam (pipeline wiring + smoke), luke (runtime tag mapping).

maria: assigned. I'll open a tracking ticket and a minimal RFC addendum with examples. also add a test corpus: 6 recent regressions + 10 benign changes to tune heuristics.

sam: minor: ensure admit-lint outputs a machine-readable JSON (lint_errors:[], lint_warnings:[]) so bench infra can decide to bail or continue.

jia: agreed. format example: ```{"errors":[{"kind":"missing_output","name":"logits"}],"warnings":[{"kind":"shape_mismatch","field":"past_key_values"}]}```

luke: final thought: don't encode runtime workarounds in lint heuristics. keep lint purely detection; rollouts/automatic mapping are separate policies in rollout layer. helps separation of concerns.

maria: excellent. next: I'll post the addendum and the test corpus link here. aim to have staging run results reviewed Wednesday. thanks all :rocket:
